$comment: Seed for milestone A1. Single source of truth for DxAudio colors and type; banner SVGs, Editor USS and docs CSS are generated from this file. Surfaces and type are shared with the DxKit family (DxMessaging, DxVisualizer).

accent.$comment: badgeFill carries white 11px badge text at >= 4.5:1; base does not.

severity.$comment: Severity colors never reuse a signal color. Shape always accompanies color.

editor.$comment: Editor windows keep Unity's skin grays; brand color is limited to tab strips, selection, and signal/severity marks.

type.$comment: Editor UI uses Unity's own font; brand faces only in docs, banners and window headers.
